scripts.build:dry: npm run build:frontend && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.cf-typegen:check: npm run cf-typegen && git diff --exit-code -- worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.test: vitest run --passWithNoTests test/unit test/integration test/contract test/parity test/safety
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p src/app/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/context-pack/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/release-gate/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/browser-artifact/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:app && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:context-pack && npm run test:release-gate && npm run test:browser-artifact && npm run test:pilot-activation && npm run test:app && npm run cf-typegen:check && npm run build:dry
